title: Mendoza Wine Bus Tour Hop On Hop Off Wineries Experience

redemption.specialInstructions:
We suggest you to confirm the booking details with us prior to travel, or upon arrival at your destination. Please note that departure times and locations may vary slightly.
If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact us!

OFFICE NUMBER: (+54 11) 3221-8400 (Mon to Sun from 9 to 18 Hs)
EMERGENCY MOBILE: (+54 911) 4991-4035 (After office hours)

description:
Explore Mendoza’s renowned wine country with the Wine Bus Tour, a structured hop-on hop-off experience designed for wine lovers. Enjoy visits to selected wineries with guided tastings and pre-arranged access, all while traveling comfortably between vineyards.

This service offers full-day and half-day options across different wine routes, allowing you to choose your preferred itinerary while following a fixed schedule with confirmed stops.

The tour includes round-trip transportation from designated meeting points and a bilingual guide (Spanish, English, Portuguese), making it ideal for travelers who want a flexible yet organized wine experience.

exclusions.otherDescription: Winery entrance fees and wine tastings (paid on site)

additionalInfo.description: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
You must indicate your preferred pick-up point at the time of booking.
It includes transportation only for the winery excursion. The transfer ticket price does not include winery visits or wine tastings.
Alcohol consumption is not allowed for passengers under 18
Each departure follows a set Wine Route; no prior booking at wineries is required

cancellationPolicy.description: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
